experiment: P3.4: held-out test of the frozen P3.3 controllers (P3.0 revision 5, D33): test squares x test week x radio realizations 100-199; decisions on the frozen development model, outcomes on the test tables; nothing tuned
status: pre-registered 2026-11-11; not yet run; no test-week trace content and no realization 100-199 has been read

frozen.note: all other frozen items (seasonal profile, forecast quantiles, development x* thresholds, maximum-capacity fallbacks, test squares a_ref, development T_0.5, development radio and energy tables) are read from P3.3 run 2 outputs, whose hashes are checked by gate G0

traces.rule: test squares x test week, x = g a / a_ref with the frozen development-week a_ref, quantized as in P3.3; slots without recorded activity count as zero traffic and are reported; no square is excluded

radio.population: p3_2c_energy_ledger.build_population with the realization index of every random stream offset by 100 (same seed and streams); checked by gate G1

scope_note: the 14 energy scenarios on the primary 50 dBm radio; the 53 and 43 dBm radio sensitivities (development only) are not re-tested

labels.aon: all 7.2 GHz cells on, UL enabled (savings reference, D28)
labels.exh: online exhaustive per-slot optimizer (MPC with H = 1)
labels.oracle: perfect traffic foresight on the frozen development model, zero avoidable violations (stricter than the 1 % budget)
labels.oracle_budget: perfect traffic foresight on the frozen development model, the same 1 % avoidable-violation allowance per run as the online controllers (Lagrangian, certified upper and lower bounds)
labels.oracle_test: perfect traffic foresight AND the test radio table (full-information reference)

holdout.temporal: the traffic of 18-24 November 2013 is excluded from tuning and from every frozen item
holdout.radio: realizations 100-199 are excluded from development; the controllers decide on the development model and are scored on the test table
holdout.spatial: the test squares are excluded from controller tuning, the forecast fit and the thresholds; their selection used their development-week mean activity and their normalization a_ref is their own development-week busiest hour (historical site information, disclosed); a strict spatial test with normalization learned only from development squares is not part of P3.4

oracle_budget.rule: per run: minimum energy subject to avoidable all-user violation <= 1 % of the run time on the decision model; DP of energy + lambda x violation seconds, bisection on log10 lambda; upper bound = best plan within the budget, lower bound = max over evaluated lambda of (DP value - lambda x budget); if the budget cannot be met at the largest lambda the zero-violation oracle plan is used and counted

statistics.method: paired comparisons on the same squares, week and realizations; energy ratios and gaps: pigeonhole bootstrap resampling test squares and radio realizations independently (crossed design); violation-share differences: bootstrap over test squares (compliance tables are pooled over realizations); 10-minute slots and realizations are never treated as independent weeks

H1.rule: mpc at 50 dBm, primary S0 and S2, both mixes, g in {1, 2}: saving vs aon (pooled mean energy over test squares and realizations) >= 3 % (S0) / 10 % (S2), the 95 % pigeonhole interval of the saving above 0, and mpc avoidable all-user violation share (pooled over the test squares) <= 1 %; held iff all 8 cells pass

H2.rule: at 26/74, g in {1, 1.5, 2}, S0-S2: avoidable all-user violation share of thr_dl (UL-agnostic) minus thr_ul (UL-aware) >= 1 percentage point and its 95 % square-bootstrap interval above 0; held iff all 9 cells pass

H4.rule: unavoidable all-user share (no pattern complies; table and traffic only): at 26/74 <= 1 % at g = 2.0 and >= 1 % at g = 2.5 (the feasibility boundary lies in (2.0, 2.5]); at 10/90 <= 1 % at g = 3.0; held iff all three

Q3.rule: (E_mpc - E_oracle) / E_aon (pooled means; oracle = zero-violation perfect-foresight benchmark on the same frozen model) <= 1 point (S0) / 5 points (S2) in each H1 cell; held iff all 8 pass; the gap to oracle_budget (same 1 % allowance) and to oracle_test is reported alongside, not scored

predictions.not_claimed: no prediction states that mpc outperforms exh or thr_ul; their paired differences are reported (review point A)

development_basis: P3.3 run 2 development values (mpc saving vs aon, g = 1 / 2): 10/90 S0 10.9 / 5.7 %, S2 42.7 / 31.2 %; 26/74 S0 10.8 / 5.5 %, S2 38.9 / 20.7 %; mpc violations <= 1 %; thr_dl - thr_ul at 26/74: +2.1 to +44 points; unavoidable share 26/74: 0.2 % (g = 2), 5.5 % (g = 2.5); 10/90 0.1 % (g = 3); mpc - oracle gap <= 0.3 point (S0), <= 2.6 points (S2)
reported: per controller x mix x g x scenario on the test data: energy per site-day, saving vs aon with its 95 % pigeonhole interval (qualified only where both meet the 1 % budget), avoidable / unavoidable / total failure shares under the three criteria, transitions, gap seconds, J per delivered Mbit, cells on, pattern shares; paired gaps mpc - exh, mpc - thr_ul, mpc - oracle, mpc - oracle_budget, mpc - oracle_test, exh - oracle; violation differences thr_dl - thr_ul, mpc - exh; offline table time and online decision times

gates.G0_provenance: P3.3 run 2 manifest, git head, config hash and every output hash; frozen parameters and test squares equal this config; all 14 trace hashes; code constants equal this config
gates.G1_heldout_population: the offset builder with offset 0 equals p3_2c.build_population bitwise (2 realizations); the test population draws exactly realizations 100-199, 6 random-stream calls each
gates.G2_test_traces: every test-week file aligned to the local day (144 slots, none outside, none misaligned); 25 test squares disjoint from the development squares; slots without activity and clipped slots reported
gates.G3_frozen_reproduction: with the frozen development model the development traces hash equal P3.3 F9, and every controller reproduces P3.3 development energy and all-user violation share exactly (<= 1e-12) for 26/74 S0 and 10/90 S2 at all seven g
gates.G5_all_user: test table: identity and monotonicity as P3.3 F4
gates.G7_ledger: 100 random test runs recomputed by the independent scalar loop on the test model (as P3.3 F6)
gates.G8_causality: every non-oracle frozen controller on the held-out traces: 20 runs x 5 cuts (as P3.3 F7)
gates.G9_budget_oracle: lower bound <= upper bound for every run; 6 cells evaluated; runs whose budget cannot be met counted
gates.G10_times: test-table construction time and per-decision times recorded with the machine

decision_rules.all_gates_pass: P3.4 is the held-out result of record for Phase 3; the predictions are scored as registered and reported whether they hold or fail; next: the publication-readiness audit
decision_rules.gate_fails: stop; keep the evidence; diagnose; any change after test outcomes are seen is disclosed and the affected results are no longer an untouched held-out test

limitations: Milan November 2013 Internet activity tests robustness to real temporal demand patterns, not 2026 6G traffic; it is a CDR count, not bytes
seven held-out days cannot establish seasonal generalization

the decision space is eight sector-index patterns applied network-wide (homogeneous frame, D15), not independent control of 57 sectors; the sub-millisecond decision time must not be extrapolated to that problem
the online decision time excludes the offline construction of the feasibility table (hours on a laptop), reported separately
all results are conditional on the radio, hardware, traffic and service models of P3.1-P3.3
declared_before_registration: Every P3.3 development result (runs 1 and 2) was seen before registration; the predictions are development-informed (development_basis).
The test-week files were downloaded and hashed in P3.3; no test-week content and no realization 100-199 has been read.
Unit tests: 5 (toy tables); full suite passing.

One smoke run before registration (--smoke-realizations 2, scratch folder, 541 s) with the 7 real development files and 7 SYNTHETIC test-week files, so that no test-week content was read: every gate G0-G10 computable and passing; G3 (frozen reproduction of every P3.3 development result to <= 1e-12) passed on the real development data; verdict forced FAIL; only gate lines printed; outputs not opened.
